items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: I think Brunus was in New York at that period with Bill Davison and Condon.

ctx.x: Was Brunus and Tony Peretti around? They used to go in. Tony Peretti did, I don't remember having seen Brunus at the Victory Club.
No, as a matter of fact, I think Brunus was in New York at that period with Bill Davison and Condon. Oh yes. I think Brunus...
It may be a little later than the period I'm thinking of.
